IMPORTANT_NOTES: total_this_year: date-guard gap-filled dgn window 2026-11-03 (spend RM353.16, 12 leads) ditambah pada cumulative run lepas (hingga 2026-11-02) - total kini RM716.91, 18 results, CPL RM39.83, period 2026-01-01..2026-11-03.

2 campaign baru (PCS26 LOKASI, WHATSFORM ENG) mula deliver 03/11 - PCS ZON B prestasi baik (CPL RM13.90) tapi PCS ZON A & WHATSFORM ENG RED pada data awal (CPL RM92.32-125.75 & RM64.28, sample kecil).
Ad PBMO4 lulus review (RESOLVED); adset baru '041126 CONVERSION POSTER' (RM20/hari) lulus review malam 03/11 - total bajet ABO naik RM400 -> RM420.

section_2_red_flags.purpose: Senarai campaign/adset bermasalah (RED/YELLOW) + apa yang berubah sejak run lepas.

total_this_year.note: Date-guard: cumulative run lepas (hingga 2026-11-02: spend RM363.75, 6 results) + gap window 2026-11-03 ditarik fresh dari Meta (spend RM353.16, 12 results: 11 website_lead + 1 whatsform). Frequency direcompute = impressions/reach = 46332/34192 = 1.36.
total_this_year.excluded_note: Tiada campaign AWARENESS dalam akaun ni. Semua 3 campaign (PBMO Website Leads, PCS26 LOKASI Website Leads, WHATSFORM ENG custom conversion) disertakan dalam combined sebab semua track lead-type conversion.

section_3_account_overview.cpl_basis: Blended CPL (semua lead conv_type digabung: Website leads fb_pixel_lead + WhatsFormSubmit custom conversion). Tiada campaign AWARENESS dikecualikan - WHATSFORM ENG (objective OUTCOME_ENGAGEMENT) disertakan sebab track lead melalui custom conversion WhatsFormSubmit.
section_3_account_overview.trend_7D_vs_14D: Tiada beza (CPL 7D = 14D = RM39.84) - semua spend bermula 28/10, window 14D = 7D sebenarnya. Membaik berbanding run lepas (RM60.63).

section_4_performance_trend.observation: Lonjakan besar semalam (12 leads, hari terbaik akaun ni) didorong PCS ZON B (8 leads) yg prestasi bagus. Tapi CPL blended masih RED (RM39.84) sebab PCS ZON A (1 lead/RM125.75), WHATSFORM ENG (1 lead/RM64.28) dan PBMO2 (RM65.38) menarik purata naik. Volume & hari data masih kecil - trend akan lebih jelas 2-3 hari lagi.
